issues.problem: Active card border is a heavier, near-black ~2px outline in the build; reference has a thinner, softer dark-green ~1px border. Card also ends at y~156 instead of ~155.
issues.fix: Reduce active card border to 1px with the reference dark-green tone (not near-black); keep height at 61px (box-sizing: border-box so the border does not add height).

issues.problem: Everything below the first card sits 1px lower than reference: Central Africa title y~186 vs 185, Indian Ocean y~256 vs 255, Add place / Share label y~327 vs 326. Amazon text is also ~1px right (x~1178 vs 1177).
issues.fix: Remove the extra 1px in the first card's height or the first gap (likely border adding to height); card pitch should be exactly 70px from y=94.

issues.problem: '2019' label is at ~(1347,796) vs reference (1345,794); arrows at x~1389/1412, y~797 vs reference x~1386/1409, y~793. Label and arrows are 2-4px right and low.
issues.fix: Shift the year label + arrow group left ~2-3px and up ~2-3px (reduce right offset / align-items baseline with the 'Pick a year' title; check line-height of the arrow glyphs).

issues.problem: Faded future bars differ from reference in the diff (heights/opacity of the last 5-6 bars, x~1320-1415), bars read slightly different in opacity and edge position.
issues.fix: Match per-bar heights and the faded opacity of the post-selection bars to the Figma values; verify bar width/gap so the last bar ends at x~1416.

issues.problem: Card is ~1px narrower (right edge ~353 vs 354) and second line sits ~1px higher (y~505 vs 506); pin marker is ~1px higher (y~447 vs 448).
issues.fix: Increase line gap between title and subtitle by 1px (line-height/margin-top) and widen card 1px (padding-right or letter-spacing); nudge pin top +1px.

issues.problem: Dotted route between stop 2 and stop 3 is offset ~1-2px from reference along its whole length (solid red in diff), and the sailboat icon is shifted ~1px.
issues.fix: Adjust the second path's control point / dash offset so dots land on reference coordinates; nudge sailboat ~1px.

issues.problem: Minus button, slider track start and knob are ~1px left (571/593/824 vs 572/594/825).
issues.fix: Add 1px left offset to the volume control group (gap after VOLUME label +1px).

issues.problem: Pill is ~1px narrower (right edge ~379 vs 380); text slightly tighter.
issues.fix: Add 1px to right padding or match letter-spacing of the caption text.

issues.problem: Placeholder text is ~1px right (x~96 vs 95) and renders slightly differently beyond pure anti-aliasing.
issues.fix: Reduce input padding-left by 1px.

issues.fix: Reduce chip horizontal padding by 0.5px per side (e.g. 14px -> 13.5px) or match the Figma letter-spacing on chip text; verify chip widths 59/60/88 and 84/82/60.

issues.problem: Card contents and following cards drift 1px down: Amazon subtitle 137 vs 136, card bottom 156 vs 155, Central Africa 186/207 vs 185/206, Indian Ocean 256/277 vs 255/276, Add place and Share labels 327 vs 326. issues.fix: Active card is 1px too tall: reduce its height/padding-bottom by 1px (target 94->155 incl. border) and shift its inner content 1px left (border width probably counted twice; use box-sizing: border-box).

issues.problem: '2019' label is 1px right (1347 vs 1346) and the arrow pair is 2px right (1388/1411 vs 1386/1409). Dimmed future bars (2020-2025) show small differences in the diff, slightly different opacity/edges vs reference.
issues.fix: Reduce the gap between the year label and arrows by 1px and add 2px right padding/margin to the arrow group; verify future-bar opacity matches Figma (approx 0.45) and bar x positions past the selected 2019 bar.

issues.problem: Minus button, slider track and thumb are 1px left (minus centre 571 vs 572, track 593-901 vs 594-902, thumb 824 vs 825).
issues.fix: Add 1px to the gap between the VOLUME label and the minus button (or to the label width).

issues.problem: Pill is ~1px narrower (right edge 379 vs 380), text ends 369 vs 370.
issues.fix: Increase pill right padding by 1px or match caption letter-spacing to Figma.

fable.notes: Very close build: every element is present, text content is exact, colours, icons, map route and layering match.
